messages:
maria-plateng: quick sync — posting progress on the v2 compatibility gate. TL;DR: canary starts Friday, but we still have two blocking SDK test failures and an infra config mismatch reported by CI.

tom-infra: what are the exact blockers? I saw a `404` in the canary proxy logs yesterday but thought it was transient.

qiao-sdk: SDK tests failing on 1) streaming handshake (chunk boundary edge-case) and 2) header compatibility when `X-Client-API-Version` is present. I pushed a failing test to the `v2-compat-fixes` branch: `pytest tests/streaming/test_handshake.py::test_chunk_boundary`

lee-ml: infra mismatch is that `model-routing` still has the old feature-flag key `routing.v1_override` enabled on canary nodes; v2 expects `routing.v2_alias`. That causes fallback paths to be inconsistent.

maria-plateng: thanks — ownership notes: qiao for SDK fix, tom for infra flag change + canary rollout, lee please validate model routing once flag is swapped. Sam, product to confirm comms window?

sam-product: comms ok for Friday afternoon CET -> low traffic. We'll notify customers in the migration cohort (list in Confluence). Also will prepare rollback blurb.

qiao-sdk: working on handshake patch now. ETA ~3h. I can add a header compatibility test matrix too.

tom-infra: I'll flip the feature-flag on dev first, then canary (one cluster at a time). Plan: dev -> canary-1 -> canary-2 -> prod gate. Each step 30min smoke. If we see >0.5% error rate or latency p95 regress >20% we halt.

maria-plateng: gating criteria spelled out: 1) functional tests green (SDK + smoke) 2) p50/p95 latency delta <= 15% vs v1 baseline 3) error rate <0.5% 4) no customer-impacting 5xxs for 60m. Owners must ACK in thread before proceeding.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: `canary/v2-compat/2026-06-11` — kickoff scheduled 2026-06-11T13:00Z. See /deploys/1789001234 in the deploy dashboard.

qiao-sdk: ack — will notify here when tests pass.

lee-ml: acked for routing validation; will run regression suite right after tom flips flag.

maria-plateng: action items: qiao (fix + new tests), tom (flag flip + canary orchestration), lee (regression), sam (customer comms + rollback blurb). Please drop quick check-ins here as each step completes. If anyone wants to postpone to Monday, say now. :eyes:

qiao-sdk: quick note — minor API contract change: streaming chunk delimiter `

` vs `


` was inconsistent across languages. I'll add normalization in the SDK to avoid forcing server changes. That should unblock without server-side delta.

tom-infra: good call. I'll still change feature-flag on dev now so we can run the integration tests.

maria-plateng: great. If all green I'll promote canary to canary-2 by 14:00Z and update this thread. Also we should tag the migration owners in the release notes: `@qiao-sdk`, `@tom-infra`, `@lee-ml`.

sdk-ci-bot: CI: tests failing (streaming handshakes) — see https://ci.redwood/1789001234/jobs/67 for logs.

maria-plateng: ok folks — keep updates short here. Plan remains Friday canary, rollback ready, owners acknowledged. If any blockers appear that require a server contract change we pause and discuss alternatives. :thumbsup:
